name: Phuket
description: Phuket is one of the southern provinces (changwat) of Thailand. It consists of the island of Phuket, the country's largest island, and another 32 smaller islands off its coast. Phuket lies off the west coast of mainland Thailand in the Andaman Sea. Phuket Island is connected by the Sarasin Bridge to Phang Nga province to the north. The next nearest province is Krabi, to the east across Phang Nga Bay.

name: Bali
tagline: Province in Lesser Sunda Islands, Indonesia
description: Bali is an Indonesian island and province and the westernmost of the Lesser Sunda Islands. East of Java and west of Lombok, the province includes the island of Bali and a few smaller offshore islands, notably Nusa Penida, Nusa Lembongan, and Nusa Ceningan to the southeast. The provincial capital, Denpasar, is the most populous city in the Lesser Sunda Islands. The upland town of Ubud in Greater Denpasar is considered Bali's cultural centre, famed for its rice terraces, temples and beaches.

name: Kyoto
tagline: City in the Kansai region of Japan
description: Kyoto, officially Kyoto City, is the capital city of Kyoto Prefecture in the Kansai region of Japan's largest and most populous island of Honshu. Once the imperial capital for over a thousand years, it is the cultural anchor of the Greater Kyoto region, renowned for its classical Buddhist temples, Shinto shrines, imperial palaces, traditional wooden machiya houses and seasonal cherry blossom and autumn foliage.

name: Zermatt
description: Zermatt is a municipality in the district of Visp in the German-speaking section of the canton of Valais in Switzerland. A car-free mountain resort at the foot of the Matterhorn, it is one of the world's premier destinations for skiing, mountaineering and alpine hiking, with a year-round population of about 5,800.

name: Santorini
tagline: Greek island in the Aegean Sea
description: Santorini, officially Thira, is a Greek island in the southern Aegean Sea, about 200 km southeast of the mainland. It is the largest island of a small, circular archipelago formed by the Santorini caldera, famous for its whitewashed cliff-top villages, dramatic sunsets over the caldera, volcanic black-and-red beaches and ancient Akrotiri ruins.

name: Marrakech
description: Marrakesh or Marrakech is the fourth-largest city in Morocco. One of the four imperial cities and capital of the Marrakesh-Safi region, it lies west of the foothills of the Atlas Mountains and is known for its walled medina, bustling souks, historic palaces, gardens and the lively Jemaa el-Fnaa square.

name: Cancun
description: Cancún is the most populous city in the Mexican state of Quintana Roo, on the northeast coast of the Yucatán Peninsula. A significant Caribbean tourist destination, it is situated on the Caribbean Sea just north of the Riviera Maya, and encompasses the Hotel Zone, the main area for beach resorts and tourism.
